answer: Rationed issuance caps how fast any operator can mint agent keys. The forge, the only contract that creates keys, opens once per epoch at dawn and mints at most 200. Each applicant burns a 2 POA ticket, and winners are drawn from that epoch's pulse, a public random beacon published after tickets close, so no one can time entries to it. With 4,000 tickets in, each wins at 5%; a farm wanting 1,000 keys buys about 20,000 tickets, 40,000 POA burned, and every ticket it adds dilutes its own odds further. Even winning every slot, 1,000 keys take 5 epochs.
